no_bid_reason: Visakoivu Oy meets six of the seven eligibility requirements in Section 3 (M001-M006), but fails M007: clause 3.7 requires at least one reference project with a contract value of at least EUR 2,000,000 within the last five years, and the tenderer's largest reference project on file (REF02, Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue, kiinteistonhoidon ja LVI-ylapidon puitesopimus) is valued at EUR 1,650,000, which falls short of that threshold. Section 3 states that failure to meet any one eligibility requirement excludes the tenderer regardless of technical or commercial merit, so this is a genuine no-bid, not a curable gap.
